name: apilocker
stderr:
Usage: apilocker [options] [command]

API Locker — one vault for LLM keys, service API keys, and OAuth credentials

Options:
  -V, --version                 output the version number
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  register [options]            Register this device with your API Locker
                                account
  devices                       Manage devices registered to your account
  store [options]               Store a credential in the vault
  list [options]                List stored credentials grouped by category
                                (LLM / Service / OAuth)
  delete <keyId>                Delete a stored key
  rotate [options] <alias>      Replace a credential value in the vault (name
                                and metadata stay the same)
  rename <oldAlias> <newAlias>  Rename a credential in the vault (alias only;
                                value and metadata unchanged)
  pause <alias>                 Pause proxy access for a credential
                                (reveal/run/get/env still work)
  resume <alias>                Resume proxy access for a paused credential
  import [options] [file]       Import credentials from an existing .env file
                                into the vault
  run [options]                 Run a command with vault secrets injected as
                                environment variables
  get [options] <alias>         Print a credential value to stdout (for
                                scripting)
  env [options]                 Emit shell-eval-able export statements for the
                                given keys
  init [options]                Create a .apilockerrc in this directory to pin
                                vault keys to the project
  token                         Manage scoped access tokens
  activity [options]            View audit log of credential access (use
                                --follow for live streaming)
  doctor                        Run a security health check on your vault and
                                surface actionable advice
  update                        Check for a newer version of apilocker on npm
  mcp                           MCP integration — run as stdio server or print
                                client config
  oauth                         Manage OAuth 2.1 grants — remote MCP clients
                                that can access your vault
  sync [options] <target>       Push vault credentials to deployment targets
                                (wrangler, vercel, etc.)
  help [command]                display help for command
